newsitem.title: UK: London Stock Exchange signs Sequal sale agreement.
newsitem.headline: London Stock Exchange signs Sequal sale agreement.

text.p: The London Stock Exchange on Monday said it had agreed the sale of Sequal, its electronic trade matching, transaction reporting and electronic trade confirmation (ETC) system to Thomson Electronic Settlements Group.
Sequal will initially continue to operate in its present form alongside Thomson ESG's existing ETC service, OASYS Global.
The Exchange said the sale was consistent with its strategy of concentrating on core activities while working with service providers to ensure the market's needs were met effectively.

"We are very pleased with this agreement which ensures the further development of Sequal by a major service provider which is committed to delivering first class services to the market," said the Exchange's director of operations Christine Dann.
Thomson is to enhance the Sequal service to ensure clients are able to meet the transaction reporting obligations of the Securities and Futures Authority.
The Exchange will remain involved in the development of the Sequal business via an industry advisory board.

"The decision to incorporate Sequal into our current range of services furthers Thomson's ability to work closely with the industry to offer greater value to the securities market through alliances with key European organisations such as the London Stock Exchange," said Alastair Hazell, managing director Thomson Financial Services, Europe.
Thomson ESG is a unit of Thomson Corporation of Canada.
